online_safe_inputs: own hand, candidate trump, off-risk/count exposure, auction/score when available
report_only_labels: make/set rate, bid regret, unnecessary bid margin, partner hidden rescue ownership
pilot_evidence: rich bidding-risk slice over 560 eval decisions; exact static hand enumeration for risk traps
pilot_metric: rich-vs-raw regret delta; static risk prevalence
supporting_detail: rich:bidding_risk regret 3.442 -> 2.349; best static low-risk candidate in 27.74% of hands; any strong-trump bad-risk trap in 20.12% of hands
claim_ledger_recommendation: no central change; treat as underpowered proxy evidence
caveat: No auction counterfactual or calibrated make threshold is present; raw bid height is not style.
